_comment: COUGAR v1.0 LONG book — long-leaders leg of the U.S. equity long/short fund. Each tick it ranks the tokenized US-equity universe (config.equities, intersected with the live board + a liquidity floor) by 24h relative strength (own 24h return minus the equity-universe mean), takes the top rankPoolSize, and LONGS those with positive excess + a confirming 4h/1h uptrend (blow-off guard via rsiOverbought). Leverage clamped to maxLeverage then each name's HL venue max. Pairs with the SHORT book (cougar-short-config.json) on a SEPARATE, equally-funded wallet so the pair is ~market-neutral. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, cooldowns, DSL via runtime-long.yaml. Producer launched with COUGAR_LEG=long.
_persona: U.S. equity dispersion — longs the strongest tokenized stocks by relative strength, trend-confirmed, market-neutral vs the short book. Exploits the wide winner-loser spread in equities. equities is the trade.xyz US-equity whitelist; new listings auto-join once added and live on the board.
